c74object.name: void.sm.writer
c74object.digest: Indexed shared memory writer for control-rate numeric data
c74object.description:
void.sm.writer writes control-rate numeric data into a POSIX shared memory segment following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2).
The shared memory layout starts with a fixed header containing identity, versioning, topology, epoch, frame counter, and ownership information. This header is followed by a contiguous array of 32-bit floating point values organized as channels by length.
The writer supports indexed and sequential writing modes and explicitly recreates the shared memory segment whenever its structural parameters change. This guarantees deterministic synchronization with all compatible readers.
This object is part of the VOID Shared Memory ecosystem and is designed for robust inter-application communication with environments such as TouchDesigner and other Max instances.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the POSIX shared memory segment.
Writers and readers must use the same name to communicate. This argument is optional and can also be set using the @name attribute.

objarg.name: channels

inlet.description:
Receives messages to write numeric data into shared memory.
A list writes values sequentially in channel-major order.
The set message followed by an index and one or more values writes data starting at the specified channel index.
An integer selector followed by values is also interpreted as an indexed write.
The destroy message explicitly destroys the shared memory segment.
The reset message forces a full structural reset of the shared memory segment.

outlet.description:
Outputs status messages describing the shared memory state.
The waiting message indicates that the writer is enabled but cannot yet create a valid shared memory segment.
The connected message indicates that a shared memory segment has been successfully created and mapped.
The disconnected message indicates that the writer is disabled or not currently connected.
The error_open message indicates that the shared memory segment could not be created or mapped.
The destroyed message indicates that the shared memory segment has been explicitly destroyed.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment.
Changing this attribute triggers a full shared memory reset when the writer is enabled.

attribute.name: connect
attribute.description:
Enables or disables the shared memory writer.
When enabled, the shared memory segment is created. When disabled, the segment is closed and invalidated.

attribute.name: channels
attribute.description:
Number of channels stored in shared memory.
Changing this attribute triggers a full shared memory reset when the writer is enabled.

attribute.name: length
attribute.description:
Number of samples stored per channel.
Changing this attribute triggers a full shared memory reset when the writer is enabled.
